identification: Single wide, tall live-edge timber slab, about 2 m long and 40 to 50 cm wide, pale ring-porous grain with a long crack and knot through the upper section, chalked 1402 23/10/26. Catalogued walnut but the pale colour suggests it may be another local timber (e.g. macrocarpa or elm); Gowans titles are loose. Series of several adjacent slabs (1396-1403) in the same sale.
